Analysing workforce utilisation, facility layout, operational data and production schedules and costs to determine optimum worker and equipment efficiencies. Help in resource allocation, project scheduling, and identifying potential risks to meet project deadlines and budgets.    Qualification & experience   Relevant qualification at the level of a bachelor’s degree or higher, OR at least 5 years of relevant work experience, will substitute for formal qualifications.  Strong communication skills  Intermediate-level user of Microsoft Office  Continuous improvement experience and willingness to be hands-on.
